question: Which books in the catalog are published by Yale University Press?
sql: SELECT b.title FROM books b JOIN publishers p ON b.publisher_id = p.id WHERE p.publisher = 'Yale University Press' ORDER BY b.title

question: Which authors have written a book published by W&N?
sql: SELECT DISTINCT a.name FROM authors a JOIN authored au ON a.id = au.author_id JOIN books b ON au.book_id = b.id JOIN publishers p ON b.publisher_id = p.id WHERE p.publisher = 'W&N' ORDER BY a.name

question: How many books did each translator work on? Show only translators who translated more than one book.
sql: SELECT tr.name, COUNT(*) AS book_count FROM translators tr JOIN translated t ON tr.id = t.translator_id GROUP BY tr.id, tr.name HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY book_count DESC, tr.name

question: How many books did each publisher release in the catalog? Show only publishers with at least 3 books, sorted by the number of books in descending order.
sql:
SELECT p.publisher, COUNT(b.id) AS num_books
FROM publishers p
JOIN books b ON b.publisher_id = p.id
GROUP BY p.publisher
HAVING COUNT(b.id) >= 3
ORDER BY num_books DESC, p.publisher;

question: For each country, how many authors are in the catalog? List only countries with more than 2 authors, sorted by author count descending and then by country name.
sql:
SELECT country, COUNT(*) AS author_count
FROM authors
GROUP BY country
HAVING COUNT(*) > 2
ORDER BY author_count DESC, country;

question: What is the average page count for books in each format (paperback vs hardcover)?
sql:
SELECT format, ROUND(AVG(pages), 2) AS avg_pages
FROM books
GROUP BY format
ORDER BY format;

question: How many books were published in each year? Sort by year ascending.
sql:
SELECT year, COUNT(*) AS book_count
FROM books
GROUP BY year
ORDER BY year;

question: Which authors have written more than one book in the catalog? Show their names and the number of books, sorted by number of books descending and then by name.
sql:
SELECT a.name, COUNT(DISTINCT au.book_id) AS book_count
FROM authors a
JOIN authored au ON au.author_id = a.id
GROUP BY a.id, a.name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT au.book_id) > 1
ORDER BY book_count DESC, a.name;

question: For each book, what is the average rating and how many ratings did it receive? Show only books with an average rating of 4 or higher, sorted by average rating descending and then by book title.
sql:
SELECT b.title, ROUND(AVG(r.rating), 2) AS avg_rating, COUNT(*) AS num_ratings
FROM books b
JOIN ratings r ON r.book_id = b.id
GROUP BY b.id, b.title
HAVING AVG(r.rating) >= 4
ORDER BY avg_rating DESC, b.title;
expected_rows: When We Cease to Understand the World
More Than I Love My Life

question: Show me the top 3 books with the highest average reader rating, along with their average rating rounded to two decimals. If two books tie, list them alphabetically by title.
sql: SELECT b.title, ROUND(AVG(r.rating), 2) AS avg_rating FROM books b JOIN ratings r ON r.book_id = b.id GROUP BY b.id, b.title ORDER BY avg_rating DESC, b.title ASC LIMIT 3;

question: Which 4 publishers have released the most books in the catalog? List the publisher name and the number of books, from most to fewest. Break ties alphabetically by publisher name.
sql: SELECT p.publisher, COUNT(b.id) AS num_books FROM publishers p JOIN books b ON b.publisher_id = p.id GROUP BY p.id, p.publisher ORDER BY num_books DESC, p.publisher ASC LIMIT 4;

question: I'm curious about the most prolific translators. Which 5 translators have worked on the most books? Show their names and the count, sorted by count descending and then by name.
sql: SELECT t.name, COUNT(DISTINCT tr.book_id) AS books_translated FROM translators t JOIN translated tr ON tr.translator_id = t.id GROUP BY t.id, t.name ORDER BY books_translated DESC, t.name ASC LIMIT 5;

question: For each publisher, what is the average page count of the books they released? Show only publishers with at least 2 books, sorted by average page count descending and then by publisher name.

question: Which translators have worked on books published by Yale University Press? Show the translator name and the number of such books, sorted by count descending and then by translator name.
sql: SELECT t.name, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS num_books FROM translators t JOIN translated tr ON t.id = tr.translator_id JOIN books b ON tr.book_id = b.id JOIN publishers p ON b.publisher_id = p.id WHERE p.publisher = 'Yale University Press' GROUP BY t.id, t.name ORDER BY num_books DESC, t.name;

question: For each book format, what is the average number of ratings received? Show the format and the average rating count, sorted by format name.
sql: SELECT b.format, ROUND(AVG(cnt.n), 2) AS avg_ratings FROM books b JOIN (SELECT book_id, COUNT(*) AS n FROM ratings GROUP BY book_id) cnt ON b.id = cnt.book_id GROUP BY b.format ORDER BY b.format;
